description: Fix timezone handling bug in healthcare appointment booking system. The backend sends UTC timestamps like '2024-03-15T17:00:00Z', but the frontend JavaScript in 'src/components/AppointmentCard.js' incorrectly handles timezone conversion, causing patients to see wrong appointment times. Your tasks: (1) Implement the 'formatAppointmentTime(utcTimestamp)' function in 'src/utils/dateHelpers.js' that properly converts UTC timestamps to user's local timezone using JavaScript Date API methods like toLocaleString(), toLocaleDateString(), or toLocaleTimeString(). (2) Refactor 'src/components/AppointmentCard.js' to import and use this utility function instead of the buggy code that strips the 'Z' timezone indicator. (3) Ensure the buggy patterns (replace('Z', '') and direct toTimeString()) are removed. The workspace is at '/home/ga/workspace/appointment-booking'. Read the README.md for context.
